summary: The Nifty has edged into the green after a flat morning, with the Sensex up about 0.4% as private banks and IT lead. A sharp slide in hospital stocks is the one weak spot.

detail.leaders: ICICI Bank, Kotak Bank, TCS, Tech Mahindra, HCLTech; Chemicals, IT, PSU Bank, Oil & Gas
detail.laggards: Hospitals (Apollo, Fortis, Max, KIMS, Yatharth down 4.5–6%); Dr Reddy's (−2.8%); BSE; Nifty Healthcare the worst sector
detail.tone: Better than 12:00: at noon the Nifty was up 26.30 (+0.12%) at 22,742.50 and the Sensex up 298.54 (+0.41%) at 72,827.61, its first sustained move above Tuesday's close. The latest headline has the Nifty near 22,750.
